claim_scope: 2′OMe gapmer 的序列和端部结构可改变 R848 条件下 TLR8 potentiation；LNA/MOE 可削弱该现象
citation: Alharbi et al. Rational design of antisense oligonucleotides modulating the activity of TLR7/8 agonists. NAR 2020
assay_context: HEK-TLR7/8 luciferase and human-cell cytokine experiments with PS gapmer ASOs plus agonist
limitations: Potentiation is agonist- and reporter-context dependent; it is not clinical immunotoxicity

claim_scope: T-rich PS ODN can potentiate TLR8 while inhibiting TLR7 in the presence of small-molecule agonists
citation: Gorden et al. Modulating responsiveness of human TLR7 and 8 to small molecule ligands with T-rich phosphorothioate oligodeoxynucleotides. Eur J Immunol 2006
assay_context: TLR-transfected HEK cells and human PBMC with R848/loxoribine
limitations: T-homopolymers and co-agonist conditions do not establish a general rule for heterogeneous therapeutic ASOs

claim_scope: 核苷修饰可降低 RNA 经 TLR3/7/8 触发的免疫激活
citation: Karikó et al. Suppression of RNA recognition by Toll-like receptors. Immunity 2005
assay_context: Human dendritic cells and TLR-expressing cells exposed to modified versus unmodified RNA
limitations: Studied RNA and several base modifications; does not directly quantify every ASO 2′ sugar/backbone pattern

claim_scope: 2′O-methyl 的免疫效应依赖短序列 motif 与位置
citation: Schmitt et al. Identification of an optimized 2′-O-methylated trinucleotide RNA motif inhibiting TLR7 and TLR8. RNA 2017
assay_context: TLR7/8 stimulation and TNF ELISA with synthetic oligoribonucleotides
limitations: Inhibitory trinucleotide motifs are context-specific and do not imply that all 2′OMe patterns inhibit

claim_scope: TLR8 sensing depends on RNA processing；2′O-methylation can impair cleavage and stimulation
citation: Bacterial RNA sensing by TLR8 requires RNase 6 processing and is inhibited by RNA 2′O-methylation. EMBO Reports 2024
assay_context: Bacterial RNA, nuclease perturbation, cytokine assays
limitations: Bacterial RNA processing is mechanistic context, not direct proof for the project’s ASO reporter rows

claim_scope: 2′OMe 并非单向抑制标签；特定位置可保留或增强 TLR8 激活
citation: Jung et al. A single naturally occurring 2′-O-methylation converts a TLR7- and TLR8-activating RNA into a TLR8-specific ligand. PLoS ONE 2015
assay_context: Synthetic rRNA-derived sequences in human immune-cell assays
limitations: Shows strong position/sequence dependence and limits broad ‘modified equals non-immunogenic’ claims

claim_scope: 最新实验将 2′OMe-G 短片段描述为 TLR7/8 拮抗检查点，同时记录结构/位置依赖
citation: Alharbi et al. 2′-O-Methyl-guanosine RNA fragments antagonize TLR7 and TLR8 to limit autoimmunity. Nat Immunol 2026
assay_context: HEK-TLR cells, THP-1 cells, short PS/2′OMe fragments and agonists
limitations: Published after the source assay; specific short-fragment mechanism may not transfer to intact gapmers

claim_scope: PS backbone can drive receptor binding and clathrin-mediated hepatic uptake
citation: Miller et al. Stabilin-1 and Stabilin-2 are specific receptors for cellular internalization of PS-ASOs in liver. NAR 2016
assay_context: Primary liver cells and recombinant Stabilin-expressing cell lines
limitations: One uptake route among several; uptake does not guarantee productive cytosolic/nuclear delivery or toxicity

claim_scope: PS-ASO 可与 EGFR 结合并改变 productive uptake；2′ chemistry affects binding
citation: Wang et al. Cellular uptake mediated by EGFR facilitates intracellular activity of PS-ASOs. NAR 2018
claim_locator: Affinity-selection and trafficking figures in PubMed record
assay_context: Cell lines; 2′MOE/cEt/2′F PS-ASOs; knockdown and trafficking
limitations: Cell-line receptor context and productive uptake are not equivalent to organismal exposure or adverse outcome

claim_scope: LNA 通过构象限制提高 DNA–RNA 杂交亲和力；效应依碱基和位置而变
citation: Kaur et al. Thermodynamics of DNA-RNA heteroduplex formation with LNA. Biochemistry 2008
assay_context: Calorimetry and optical melting of defined heteroduplexes
limitations: Biophysical duplex evidence does not by itself predict cellular potency, receptor accessibility, or toxicity

claim_scope: 2′MOE 促进 N-type 构象预组织、RNA affinity 与 nuclease resistance
citation: Tuning conformational preorganization by 2′-O-methoxyethyl modification. NAR 2002
assay_context: Solution NMR of short model oligonucleotides
limitations: Model oligomers and solution conformation do not reproduce full PS gapmer pharmacology

claim_scope: 2′MOE 可提高体内 nuclease stability；PS/PO 改变 protein binding、clearance 与组织分布
citation: Geary et al. Pharmacokinetic properties of 2′-O-MOE oligonucleotide analogs in rats. J Pharmacol Exp Ther 2001
limitations: Rat PK and fixed sequences cannot isolate every position-specific effect or human safety outcome

claim_scope: 中央 DNA gap 与修饰 wings 的组合保留 RNase H-dependent activity
citation: Kang et al. Inhibition of MDR1 by chimeric HNA antisense oligonucleotides. NAR 2004
assay_context: HNA and 2′MOE gapmers versus fully modified HNA in transfected cells
limitations: HNA comparison and transfection conditions are not identical to LNA/MOE free-uptake toxicology assays

claim_scope: 改变 PS stereochemistry 可改变 RNase H1 cleavage pattern，但不足以普遍改善 potency/safety；sequence/design 仍是主驱动
citation: Østergaard et al. Understanding PS chirality in gapmer ASOs. NAR 2020
assay_context: Systematic cEt gapmer tests in cells and mice
limitations: Stereopure gap-region study does not negate other backbone-position or protein-binding effects

claim_scope: 相同化学类别内，sequence 可显著改变 PS-ODN uptake 与亚细胞分布
citation: Benimetskaya et al. Sequence dependency of PS oligonucleotide internalization and distribution. Nucleic Acids Res 1999
assay_context: Vascular smooth muscle cells; multiple PS-ODN sequences
limitations: Cell-type-specific; nevertheless directly cautions against interpreting backbone descriptors without sequence context
